author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
Context Engineering 

Level 0 : make sure the context is there
Level 1 : make sure the LLM knows how to use the context correctly
Level 2 : figure out how to search the relevant context and show it to the LLM fast
Level 3: optimize the cost of the context search

For some reason, most people are focusing on level 2 and 3, not many people pay attention to level 0 and 1.
